## Industries

- [Industries - the markets that Fugro works in](https://www.fugro.com/industries): Fugro serves customers in three key markets: energy, water and infrastructure, with a wide range of assets, skills, and solutions tailored to our clients.
- [Supporting the energy transition for safer, sustainable world](https://www.fugro.com/industries/energy): We help drive the energy transmission, supporting energy projects every step of the way. For a safer, more sustainable world.
- [Powering a safe and sustainable future with clean energy](https://www.fugro.com/industries/energy/renewable-energy): The energy transition is driving demand for cleaner energy. At Fugro, we support renewable energy projects to decarbonise activities and deliver cleaner energy.
- [Protecting our oceans and their surrounding environments](https://www.fugro.com/industries/water): Climate change threatens our oceans and coastlines. We work together with you to reduce risks, build strong coastal environments, and protect our oceans. 
- [Driving sustainable mining through data-driven solutions](https://www.fugro.com/industries/infrastructure/critical-minerals): Powering the energy transition with critical minerals for wind turbines, electric vehicles, and solar panels. As global demand triples by 2030, Fugro's Geo-data solutions ensure safe, sustainable discovery, development, and tailings management, protecting the environment.
- [Conserve & Restoring Nature: Biodiversity & Critical Habitats](https://www.fugro.com/industries/water/nature): Fugro’s Nature solutions enhance climate mitigation and adaptation through carbon capture, nature-based solutions, and biodiversity conservation and restoration.
- [Fugro carbon capture, utilisation and storage](https://www.fugro.com/industries/energy/carbon-capture-utilisation-and-storage): Explore Fugro's advanced Geo-data solutions for effective carbon capture, utilisation, and storage (CCUS) deployment. Discover how our expertise provides the foundation for safe, reliable, and efficient CCUS implementation.
- [Fugro supports your climate adaptation journey](https://www.fugro.com/industries/water/climate): Fugro supports climate resilience efforts in both mitigating and adapting to these impacts through an informed and data-driven way.
- [Infrastructure - Building Resilient, Sustainable Solutions](https://www.fugro.com/industries/infrastructure): Infrastructure: crucial to economic growth and growing urban populations. We help develop sustainable and resilient infrastructures that will last a lifetime. 
- [Oil and natural gas](https://www.fugro.com/industries/energy/oil-and-natural-gas): The energy transition is driving demand for cleaner energy. We support oil and natural gas projects to decarbonise activities and deliver cleaner energy.
- [Nearshore Site Investigation | Coastal & Marine | Fugro](https://www.fugro.com/industries/infrastructure/nearshore-site-investigation): Nearshore site investigation using jack-up barges to capture geotechnical and geophysical data in shallow water, from 0 to 40m. Talk to Fugro.

## Portals

- [Customer Portals & Workday Access](https://www.fugro.com/portals): Access Fugro customer portals like Marinestar®, Seastar®, Starfix®, and more. Job applicants can log into Workday to view and manage applications.
- [NorthStar®](https://www.fugro.com/portals/northstar-login): NorthStar® is an integrated marine management and advisory solution created by Fugro to monitor multiple data systems and improve the performance, efficiency and safety of production assets.
- [Marine & Coastal Digital Twin with Real-Time Support](https://www.fugro.com/portals/big-ocean-insights): Discover a conversational digital twin built for marine and coastal environments. Access real-time insights, explore specialised products, and enhance decision-making with our interactive platform.
